updated_at = ?\n413\t         WHERE id = ?\",\n414\t        rusqlite::params![now.to_rfc3339(), reason, now.to_rfc3339(), id],\n415\t    )?;\n416\t\n417\t    tx.execute(\n418\t        \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at)\n419\t         VALUES (?1, 'closed', '', '', ?2, ?3)\",\n420\t        rusqlite::params![id, reason, now.to_rfc3339()],\n421\t    )?;\n422\t\n423\t    Ok(())\n424\t}\n425\t\n426\t/// Mitosis: split a parent bead into multiple child beads atomically.\n427\t///\n428\t/// This function constructs a batch of operations that:\n429\t/// 1. Creates N child beads\n430\t/// 2. Adds dependencies (each child blocks the parent) for each child\n431\t/// 3. Closes the parent bead\n432\t///\n433\t/// All operations run in a single BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, so there's no\n434\t/// risk of orphaned children if the process crashes midway.\n435\t///\n436\t/// # Arguments\n437\t/// * `parent_id` - The ID of the parent bead to split\n438\t/// * `children` - Vector of (title, type_, priority) tuples for each child\n439\t/// * `close_reason` - Reason for closing the parent (default: \"Split into children\")\n440\t///\n441\t/// # Returns\n442\t/// * `Ok(Vec<BatchOp>)` - Batch operations ready for execute_batch()\n443\t///\n444\t/// # Example\n445\t/// ```ignore\n446\t/// let ops = mitosis(\"bf-123\", vec![\n447\t///     (\"Child 1\".to_string(), \"task\".to_string(), 2),\n448\t///     (\"Child 2\".to_string(), \"bug\".to_string(), 0),\n449\t/// ], None)?;\n450\t/// let results = execute_batch(&storage, ops, &workspace_dir)?;\n451\t/// ```\n452\tpub fn mitosis(\n453\t    parent_id: &str,\n454\t    children: Vec<(String, String, i32)>,\n455\t    close_reason: Option<String>,\n456\t) -> Result<Vec<BatchOp>> {\n457\t    let mut ops = Vec::new();\n458\t\n459\t    // Create child beads\n460\t    for (title, type_, priority) in &children {\n461\t        ops.push(BatchOp::Create {\n462\t            title: title.clone(),\n463\t            type_: type_.clone(),\n464\t            priority: *priority,\n465\t            description: None,\n466\t            assignee: None,\n467\t            labels: Vec::new(),\n468\t        });\n469\t    }\n470\t\n471\t    // Add dependencies: each child blocks the parent\n472\t    // Reference children by placeholder (@0, @1, etc.)\n473\t    for (idx, _) in children.iter().enumerate() {\n474\t        ops.push(BatchOp::DepAddBlocker {\n475\t            id: parent_id.to_string(),    // parent is blocked\n476\t            blocker: format!(\"@{}\", idx), // child blocks parent\n477\t        });\n478\t    }\n479\t\n480\t    // Close the parent\n481\t    ops.push(BatchOp::Close {\n482\t        id: parent_id.to_string(),\n483\t        reason: close_reason.unwrap_or_else(|| \"Split into children\".to_string()),\n484\t    });\n485\t\n486\t    Ok(ops)\n487\t}\n488\t\n489\t/// Mitosis with extended options (description, assignee, labels).\n490\t///\n491\t/// Same as mitosis() but allows full control over child bead properties.\n492\tpub fn mitosis_ex(\n493\t    parent_id: &str,\n494\t    children: Vec<MitosisChild>,\n495\t    close_reason: Option<String>,\n496\t) -> Result<Vec<BatchOp>> {\n497\t    let mut ops = Vec::new();\n498\t\n499\t    for child in &children {\n500\t        ops.push(BatchOp::Create {\n501\t            title: child.title.clone(),\n502\t            type_: child.type_.clone(),\n503\t            priority: child.priority,\n504\t            description: child.description.clone(),\n505\t            assignee: child.assignee.clone(),\n506\t            labels: child.labels.clone(),\n507\t        });\n508\t    }\n509\t\n510\t    for (idx, _) in children.iter().enumerate() {\n511\t        ops.push(BatchOp::DepAddBlocker {\n512\t            id: parent_id.to_string(),    // parent is blocked\n513\t            blocker: format!(\"@{}\", idx), // child blocks parent\n514\t        });\n515\t    }\n516\t\n517\t    ops.push(BatchOp::Close {\n518\t        id: parent_id.to_string(),\n519\t        reason: close_reason.unwrap_or_else(|| \"Split into children\".to_string()),\n520\t    });\n521\t\n522\t    Ok(ops)\n523\t}\n524\t\n525\t/// Extended child bead definition for mitosis_ex.\n526\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\n527\tpub struct MitosisChild {\n528\t    pub title: String,\n529\t    #[serde(default = \"default_type\")]\n530\t    pub type_: String,\n531\t    #[serde(default = \"default_priority\")]\n532\t    pub priority: i32,\n533\t    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n534\t    pub description: Option<String>,\n535\t    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n536\t    pub assignee: Option<String>,\n537\t    #[serde(default)]\n538\t    pub labels: Vec<String>,\n539\t}\n540\t\n541\tpub fn parse_stdin() -> Result<Vec<BatchOp>> {\n542\t    let mut input = String::new();\n543\t    std::io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input)?;\n544\t\n545\t    // Try JSON first with validation\n546\t    if let Ok(json_values) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<serde_json::Value>>(&input) {\n547\t        // Validate each operation's fields before parsing\n548\t        for value in &json_values {\n549\t            validate_op_fields(value)?;\n550\t        }\n551\t        // Now parse the validated JSON\n552\t        return serde_json::from_str::<Vec<BatchOp>>(&input)\n553\t            .map_err(|e| anyhow!(\"JSON parse error: {}\", e));\n554\t    }\n555\t\n556\t    // Fall back to CLI-style parsing (one op per line)\n557\t    let mut ops = Vec::new();\n558\t    for line in input.lines() {\n559\t        let line = line.trim();\n560\t        if line.is_empty() || line.starts_with('#') {\n561\t            continue;\n562\t        }\n563\t\n564\t        // Simple parsing for: create --title \"X\" --type Y\n565\t        if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix(\"create \") {\n566\t            ops.push(parse_create(rest)?);\n567\t        } else if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix(\"dep add-blocker \") {\n568\t            ops.push(parse_dep_add(rest)?);\n569\t        } else if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix(\"close \") {\n570\t            ops.push(parse_close(rest)?);\n571\t        } else {\n572\t            return Err(anyhow!(\"Unknown operation: {}\", line));\n573\t        }\n574\t    }\n575\t\n576\t    Ok(ops)\n577\t}\n578\t\n579\tfn parse_create(input: &str) -> Result<BatchOp> {\n580\t    let mut title = None;\n581\t    let mut type_ = \"task\".to_string();\n582\t    let mut priority = 2;\n583\t    let mut description = None;\n584\t\n585\t    let parts = shell_words::split(input)?;\n586\t    let mut i = 0;\n587\t    while i < parts.len() {\n588\t        match parts[i].as_str() {\n589\t            \"--title\" => {\n590\t                i += 1;\n591\t                if i < parts.len() {\n592\t                    title = Some(parts[i].clone());\n593\t                }\n594\t            }\n595\t            \"--type\" => {\n596\t                i += 1;\n597\t                if i < parts.len() {\n598\t                    type_ = parts[i].clone();\n599\t                }\n600\t            }\n601\t            \"--priority\" => {\n602\t                i += 1;\n603\t                if i < parts.len() {\n604\t                    priority = parts[i].parse().unwrap_or(2);\n605\t                }\n606\t            }\n607\t            \"--description\" => {\n608\t                i += 1;\n609\t                if i < parts.len() {\n610\t                    description = Some(parts[i].clone());\n611\t                }\n612\t            }\n613\t            _ => {\n614\t                if title.is_none() {\n615\t                    title = Some(parts[i].clone());\n616\t                }\n617\t            }\n618\t        }\n619\t        i += 1;\n620\t    }\n621\t\n622\t    let title = title.ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Missing title for create operation\"))?;\n623\t\n624\t    Ok(BatchOp::Create {\n625\t        title,\n626\t        type_,\n627\t        priority,\n628\t        description,\n629\t        assignee: None,\n630\t        labels: Vec::new(),\n631\t    })\n632\t}\n633\t\n634\tfn parse_dep_add(input: &str) -> Result<BatchOp> {\n635\t    let parts: Vec<&str> = input.split_whitespace().collect();\n636\t    if parts.len() != 2 {\n637\t        return Err(anyhow!(\n638\t            \"dep add-blocker requires <id> <blocker>. Usage: dep add-blocker <blocked-bead> <blocking-bead>\"\n639\t        ));\n640\t    }\n641\t    Ok(BatchOp::DepAddBlocker {\n642\t        id: parts[0].to_string(),    // bead being blocked\n643\t        blocker: parts[1].to_string(), // bead that blocks\n644\t    })\n645\t}\n646\t\n647\tfn parse_close(input: &str) -> Result<BatchOp> {\n648\t    let parts: Vec<&str> = input.split_whitespace().collect();\n649\t    let id = parts\n650\t        .first()\n651\t        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Missing ID for close operation\"))?;\n652\t    let reason = if parts.len() > 1 {\n653\t        parts[1..].join(\" \")\n654\t    } else {\n655\t        \"Completed\".to_string()\n656\t    };\n657\t    Ok(BatchOp::Close {\n658\t        id: id.to_string(),\n659\t        reason,\n660\t    })\n661\t}\n662\t\n663\t#[cfg(test)]\n664\tmod tests {\n665\t    use super::*;\n666\t    use crate::id::generate_id;\n667\t    use crate::model::Status;\n668\t    use std::fs;\n669\t )?;\n\n    let blocker_exists: bool = tx.query_row(\n        \"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = ?1)\",\n        &[blocker],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    )?;\n\n    if !id_exists {\n        return Err(anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id));\n    }\n    if !blocker_exists {\n        return Err(anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", blocker));\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate dependency\n    let exists: bool = tx.query_row(\n        \"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dependencies WHERE issue_id = ?1 AND depends_on_id = ?2)\",\n        &[id, blocker],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    )?;\n\n    if exists {\n        return Err(anyhow!(\n            \"Dependency already exists: {} depends on {}\",\n            id,\n            blocker\n        ));\n    }\n\n    // Check for circular dependency (id -> blocker and blocker -> id)\n    let reverse_exists: bool = tx.query_row(\n        \"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dependencies WHERE issue_id = ?1 AND depends_on_id = ?2)\",\n        &[blocker, id],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    )?;\n\n    if reverse_exists {\n        return Err(anyhow!(\n            \"Circular dependency detected: {} <-> {}\",\n            id,\n            blocker\n        ));\n    }\n\n    // Add dependency (id depends on blocker, so blocker blocks id)\n    let now = Utc::now();\n    tx.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO dependencies (issue_id, depends_on_id, type, created_at, created_by)\n         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)\",\n        rusqlite::params![\n            id,\n            blocker,\n            DependencyType::Blocks.to_string(),\n            now.to_rfc3339(),\n            \"batch\",\n        ],\n    )?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn execute_close(tx: &Connection, id: &str, reason: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    // Verify bead exists\n    let exists: bool = tx.query_row(\n        \"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = ?1)\",\n        &[id],\n        |row| row.get(0),\n    )?;\n\n    if !exists {\n        return Err(anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id));\n    }\n\n    let now = Utc::now();\n    tx.execute(\n        \"UPDATE issues SET status = 'closed', closed_at = ?, close_reason = ?, updated_at = ?\n         WHERE id = ?\",\n        rusqlite::params![now.to_rfc3339(), reason, now.to_rfc3339(), id],\n    )?;\n\n    tx.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at)\n         VALUES (?1, 'closed', '', '', ?2, ?3)\",\n        rusqlite::params![id, reason, now.to_rfc3339()],\n    )?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Mitosis: split a parent bead into multiple child beads atomically.\n///\n/// This function constructs a batch of operations that:\n/// 1. Creates N child beads\n/// 2. Adds dependencies (each child blocks the parent) for each child\n/// 3. Closes the parent bead\n///\n/// All operations run in a single BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, so there's no\n/// risk of orphaned children if the process crashes midway.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `parent_id` - The ID of the parent bead to split\n/// * `children` - Vector of (title, type_, priority) tuples for each child\n/// * `close_reason` - Reason for closing the parent (default: \"Split into children\")\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(Vec<BatchOp>)` - Batch operations ready for execute_batch()\n///\n/// # Example\n/// ```ignore\n/// let ops = mitosis(\"bf-123\", vec![\n///     (\"Child 1\".to_string(), \"task\".to_string(), 2),\n///     (\"Child 2\".to_string(), \"bug\".to_string(), 0),\n/// ], None)?;\n/// let results = execute_batch(&storage, ops, &workspace_dir)?;\n/// ```\npub fn mitosis(\n    parent_id: &str,\n    children: Vec<(String, String, i32)>,\n    close_reason: Option<String>,\n) -> Result<Vec<BatchOp>> {\n    let mut ops = Vec::new();\n\n    // Create child beads\n    for (title, type_, priority) in &children {\n        ops.push(BatchOp::Create {\n            title: title.clone(),\n            type_: type_.clone(),\n            priority: *priority,\n            description: None,\n            assignee: None,\n            labels: Vec::new(),\n        });\n    }\n\n    // Add dependencies: each child blocks the parent\n    // Reference children by placeholder (@0, @1, etc.)\n    for (idx, _) in children.iter().enumerate() {\n        ops.push(BatchOp::DepAddBlocker {\n            id: parent_id.to_string(),    // parent is blocked\n            blocker: format!(\"@{}\", idx), // child blocks parent\n        });\n    }\n\n    // Close the parent\n    ops.push(BatchOp::Close {\n        id: parent_id.to_string(),\n        reason: close_reason.unwrap_or_else(|| \"Split into children\".to_string()),\n    });\n\n    Ok(ops)\n}\n\n/// Mitosis with extended options (description, assignee, labels).\n///\n/// Same as mitosis() but parent\n        });\n    }\n\n    ops.push(BatchOp::Close {\n        id: parent_id.to_string(),\n        reason: close_reason.unwrap_or_else(|| \"Split into children\".to_string()),\n    });\n\n    Ok(ops)\n}\n\n/// Extended child bead definition for mitosis_ex.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct MitosisChild {\n    pub title: String,\n    #[serde(default =    }\n        // Now parse the validated JSON\n        return serde_json::from_str::<Vec<BatchOp>>(&input)\n            .map_err(|e| anyhow!(\"JSON parse error: {}\", e));\n    }\n\n    // Fall back              }\n            }\n            \"--priority\" => {\n                i += 1;\n                if i < parts.len() {\n                    priority = parts[i].parse().unwrap_or(2);\n                }\n            }\n            \"--description\" => {\n                i += 1;\n                if i < parts.len() {\n                    description = Some(parts[i].clone());\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {\n                if title.is_none() {\n                    title = Some(parts[i].clone());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        i += 1;\n    }\n\n    let title = title.ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Missing title for create operation\"))?;\n\n    Ok(BatchOp::Create {\n        title,\n        type_,\n        priority,\n        description,\n        assignee: None,\n        labels: Vec::new(),\n    })\n}\n\nfn parse_dep_add(input: &str) -> Result<BatchOp> {\n    let parts: Vec<&str> = input.split_whitespace().collect();\n    if parts.len() != 2 \"d\" or \"day\": days\n2863\t/// - \"w\" or \"week\": weeks\n2864\tfn parse_time_period(period: &str) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n2865\t    let period = period.trim().to_lowercase();\n2866\t\n2867\t            type_,\n            priority,\n            description,\n            assignee,\n            label,\n        } => cmd_create(\n            &beads_dir,\n            title,\n Commands::Show { id, format, json } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_show(&beads_dir, &id, &format)\n        }\n std::fs::create_dir_all(beads_dir)?;\n\n    let config_path = beads_dir.join(\"config.yaml\");\n    if !config_path.exists() {\n        let config = format!(\n            r#\"issue_prefixes: [{}]\ndefault_priority: 2\ndefault_type: task\nclaim_ttl_minutes: 30\n\"#,\n            prefix\n        );\n        std::fs::write(&config_path, config)?;\n    }\n\n    let metadata_path = bead-forge workspace in {:?}\", beads_dir);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_create(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    title: String,\n    type_: String,\n    priority: i32,\n    description: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    labels: Vec<String>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open_with_config(&db_path, &config)?;\n\n    let count = storage.count_issues()?;\n    let prefix = get_default_prefix(&config);\n    let id = crate::id::generate_id(prefix, count);\n\n    // Validate assignee\n    validate_assignee(assignee.as_deref())?;\n\n    let mut issue = Issue::new(id.clone(), title, \".\".to_string());\n    issue.issue_type = IssueType::from_str(type_.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n    issue.priority = Priority(priority);\n    issue.description = description;\n    issue.assignee = assignee;\n    issue.labels = labels;\n\n    storage.create_issue(&issue)?;\n\n    println!(\"{}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_list(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    status: Option<String>,\n    type_: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    annotation: Option<String>,\n    limit: Option<usize>,\n    all: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Parse annotation filter (key=value format)\n    let annotation_filter = match annotation {\n        Some(ref ann) => {\n            let parts: Vec<&str> = ann.splitn(2, '=').collect();\n            if parts.len() != 2 {\n                return Err(anyhow!(\"Invalid annotation format. Use key=value\"));\n            }\n            Some((parts[0].to_string(), parts[1].to_string()))\n        }\n        None => None,\n    };\n\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let mut issues = if all {\n        // Include archived beads\n        list_all_with_archives(beads_dir)?\n    } else {\n        // Only from database\n        let mut filter = IssueFilter::default();\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            filter.status = Some(Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            filter.issue_type =\n                Some(IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        filter.assignee = assignee.clone();\n        filter.priority = priority;\n        filter.annotation = annotation_filter.clone();\n        // --limit 0 means unlimited\n        filter.limit = limit.and_then(|l| if l == 0 { None } else { Some(l) });\n        storage.list_issues(&filter)?\n    };\n\n    // Apply additional filters for --all mode (since we're not using DB filters)\n    if all {\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            let status_filter = Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.status == status_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            let type_filter = IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.issue_type == type_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref assignee_val) = assignee {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.assignee.as_deref() == Some(assignee_val));\n        }\n        if let Some(p) = priority {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.priority.0 == p);\n        }\n        if let Some((ref key, ref value)) = annotation_filter {\n            issues.retain(|i| {\n                i.annotations\n                    .get(key)\n                    .map_or(false, |v| v == value)\n            });\n        }\n        // Apply limit\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            if l != 0 {\n                issues.truncate(l);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let output_format = OutputFormat::from_str(format).unwrap_or(OutputFormat::Text);\n    let formatter = get_formatter(output_format);\n    print!(\"{}\", formatter.format_issues(&issues));\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_show(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let issue = match storage.get_issue(id)? {\n        Some(i) => i,\n        None => {\n            // Search archives\n            find_bead_in_archives(beads_dir, id)?\n                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id))?\n        }\n    };\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            // Strip dependencies/comments before serializing: NEEDLE's BrDependency\n            // format ({id, title, status, priority, dependency_type}) differs from\n            // bead-forge's Dependency format ({issue_id, depends_on_id, type, ...}).\n            // NEEDLE has #[serde(default)] on the deps field so empty is fine.\n            let mut out = issue;\n            out.dependencies = vec![];\n            out.comments = vec![];\n            // Wrap in array so NEEDLE's parse_single_bead (Vec<Bead> → first) works.\n            println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&vec![out])?);\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n            if !issue.dependencies.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Dependencies:\");\n                for dep in &issue.dependencies {\n                    println!(\"  -> {} ({})\", dep.depends_on_id, dep.dep_type);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n            if !issue.dependencies.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Dependencies:\");\n                for dep in &issue.dependencies {\n                    println!(\"  -> {} ({})\", dep.depends_on_id, dep.dep_type);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_update(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    id: &str,\n    title: Option<String>,\n Option<String>,\n    due_at: Option<String>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = validate_assignee(assignee.as_deref())?;\n    }\n\n    // Parse due_at if provided\n    let due_at_parsed = match due_at {\n        Some(date_str) => {\n            let dt = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&date_str)\n                .map_err(|_| anyhow!(\"Invalid --due-at format. Use RFC3339 format, e.g., 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z\"))?;\n            Some(dt.with_timezone(&Utc))\n        }\n        None => None,\n    };\n\n    let changes = IssueChanges {\n        title,\n        status: status.map(|s| Status::from_str(&s).ok()).flatten(),\n        priority,\n        assignee,\n        description,\n        acceptance_criteria,\n        notes,\n        design,\n        due_at: due_at_parsed,\n        ..Default::default()\n    };\n\n    storage.update_issue(id, &changes)?;\n    println!(\"Updated bead {}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_close(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    // --limit 0 means        \"json\" => {\n            // Output as JSON array: [] for empty, [candidate] for single, [c1, c2, ...] for multiple\n            println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&candidates)?);\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\n                    \"{}\",\n                    crate::format::toon::format_ready_bead(\n                        &candidate.id,\n                        &candidate.title,\n                        candidate.priority,\n                        candidate.downstream_impact,\n                        candidate.critical_float,\n                    )\n                );\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\n candidate.downstream_impact,\n                    candidate.critical_float\n                );\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_claim(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    assignee: &str,\n    model: Option<String>,\n    harness: Option<String>,\n    harness_version: Option<String>,\n    any: bool,\n    fallback: Option<&str>,\n    workspace_paths: &[PathBuf],\n    dry_run: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let claim_ttl = config.claim_ttl_minutes;\n\n    // Build worker metadata\n    let worker_metadata = WorkerMetadata {\n        worker_id: assignee.to_string(),\n        model: model.clone(),\n        harness: harness.clone(),\n        harness_version: harness_version.clone(),\n    };\n\n    if dry_run {\n        // Dry run mode - show what would be claimed\n        let candidates: Vec<(PathBuf, crate::claim::ScoredBead)> = if any || fallback == Some(\"any\")\n        {\n            // Multi-workspace dry run\n            let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n                // Auto-discover workspaces from current directory\n                find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n            } else {\n                workspace_paths.to_vec()\n            };\n\n            let mut all_candidates = Vec::new();\n            for path in &paths {\n                let local_beads_dir = path.join(\".beads\");\n                if local_beads_dir.exists() {\n                    let local_metadata = match load_metadata(&local_beads_dir) {\n                        Ok(m) => m,\n                        Err(_) => continue,\n                    };\n                    let local_db_path = local_beads_dir.join(&local_metadata.database);\n                    if let Ok(local_storage) = Storage::open(&local_db_path) {\n                        if let Ok(local_candidates) = local_storage\n                            .with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, 1, None, None))\n                        {\n                            for c in local_candidates {\n                                all_candidates.push((path.clone(), c));\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Sort by score and take top 1\n            all_candidates.sort_by(|a, b| {\n                let score_a = (b.1.downstream_impact, b.1.priority, b.1.created_at.clone());\n                let score_b = (a.1.downstream_impact, a.1.priority, a.1.created_at.clone());\n                score_a.cmp(&score_b)\n            });\n            all_candidates.into_iter().take(1).collect()\n        } else {\n            // Single workspace dry run\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let candidates =\n                storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, 1, None, None))?;\n            candidates\n                .into_iter()\n                .map(|c| (beads_dir.parent().unwrap_or(beads_dir).to_path_buf(), c))\n                .collect()\n        };\n\n        if let Some((path, candidate)) = candidates.first() {\n            match format {\n                \"json\" => {\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"bead_id\": candidate.id,\n                        \"title\": candidate.title,\n                        \"priority\": candidate.priority,\n                        \"downstream_impact\": candidate.downstream_impact,\n                        \"assignee\": assignee,\n                        \"workspace\": path.display().to_string(),\n                        \"dry_run\": true\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", output);\n                }\n                _ => {\n                    println!(\n                        \"{} (priority={}, impact={}, workspace={})\",\n                        candidate.id,\n                        candidate.priority,\n                        candidate.downstream_impact,\n                        path.display()\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        } else if format == \"json\" {\n            println!(\"{{}}\");\n        } else {\n            println!(\"No beads available to claim\");\n        }\n    } else if any {\n        // Claim from any workspace\n        let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n            // Auto-discover workspaces from current directory\n            find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n        } else {\n            workspace_paths.to_vec()\n        };\n\n        let result = claim_any(&paths, assignee, claim_ttl, Some(&worker_metadata))?;\n\n        match result {\n            Some(ClaimResult {\n                bead_id,\n                reclaimed,\n                workspace_path,\n            }) => match format {\n                \"json\" => {\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"bead_id\": bead_id,\n                        \"reclaimed\": reclaimed,\n                        \"assignee\": assignee,\n                        \"workspace\": workspace_path.map(|p| p.display().to_string())\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", output);\n                }\n                _ => {\n                    if let Some(path) = workspace_path {\n                        println!(\"{} (workspace: {})\", bead_id, path.display());\n                    } else {\n                        println!(\"{}\", bead_id);\n                    }\n                }\n            },\n            None => {\n                if format == \"json\" {\n                    println!(\"{{}}\");\n                } else {\n                    println!(\"No beads available to claim\");\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    } else if fallback == Some(\"any\") {\n        // Fallback mode: try current workspace first, then any\n        let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n        let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n        let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n        let result = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            claim(tx, assignee, claim_ttl, Utc::now(), Some(&worker_metadata))\n        })?;\n\n        match result {\n            Some(ClaimResult {\n                bead_id, reclaimed, ..\n            }) => match format {\n                \"json\" => {\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"bead_id\": bead_id,\n                        \"reclaimed\": reclaimed,\n                        \"assignee\": assignee\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", output);\n                }\n                _ => {\n                    println!(\"{}\", bead_id);\n                }\n            },\n            None => {\n                // Fallback to any workspace\n                let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n                    find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n                } else {\n                    workspace_paths.to_vec()\n                };\n\n                let result = claim_any(&paths, assignee, claim_ttl, Some(&worker_metadata))?;\n\n                match result {\n                    Some(ClaimResult {\n                        bead_id,\n                        reclaimed,\n                        workspace_path,\n                    }) => match format {\n                        \"json\" => {\n                            let output = serde_json::json!({\n                                \"bead_id\": bead_id,\n                                \"reclaimed\": reclaimed,\n                                \"assignee\": assignee,\n                                \"workspace\": workspace_path.map(|p| p.display().to_string())\n                            });\n                            println!(\"{}\", output);\n                        }\n                        _ => {\n                            if let Some(path) = workspace_path {\n                                println!(\"{} (workspace: {})\", bead_id, path.display());\n                            } else {\n                                println!(\"{}\", bead_id);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    },\n                    None => {\n                        if format ==      println!(\"    ... and {} more\", result.missing_in_sqlite.len() - 10);\n                    }\n                }\n                if !result.hash_mismatch.is_empty() {\n         }\n                    if result.hash_mismatch.len() > 10 {\n                        println!(\"    ... and {} more\", result.hash_mismatch.len() - 10);\n                    }\n    };\n\n    println!(\"{}\", count);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_batch(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    file: Option<PathBuf>,\n    json: Option<String>,\n    stdin: bool,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let       eprintln!(\n                \"[op {}] error: {}\",\n                result.op,\n                result.error.unwrap_or_default()\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_mitosis(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    id: &str,\n    children: &str,\n    reason: &str,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open_with_config(&db_path, &config)?;\n\n    // Parse children as JSON array of {title,        println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&results)?);\n        }\n        _ => {\n            // Print child IDs that were created\n            for result in &results {\n                if print_dep_tree(nodes: &[crate::storage::DepTreeNode], _storage: &Storage) -> Result<()> {\n    if nodes.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"  (no dependencies)\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Status indicators: ●=open, ◐=in_progress, ○=closed/blocked/deferred, ⊘=tombstone\n    let status_symbol = |status: &str| -> char {\n        match status {\n            \"open\" => '●',\n            \"in_progress\" => '◐',\n            \"closed\" => '○',\n            \"blocked\" => '◌',\n            \"deferred\" => '○',\n            \"tombstone\" => '⊘',\n            _ => '○',\n        }\n    };\n\n    for (i, node) in nodes.iter().enumerate() {\n        let is_cycle = node.path.contains(\"[CYCLE]\");\n\n        // Build tree prefix with proper branching\n        let mut prefix = String::new();\n        if node.depth > 0 {\n            for d in 0..node.depth as usize {\n                if d < node.depth as usize - 1 {\n                    prefix.push_str(\"│   \");\n                } else {\n                    // Check if this is the last node at this depth\n                    let is_last = nodes\n                        .iter()\n                        .skip(i + 1)\n                        .all(|n| n.depth < node.depth || (n.depth == node.depth && n.id > node.id));\n                    if is_last {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"└── \");\n                    } else {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"├── \");\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Truncate title if too long\n        let title = if node.title.len() > 60 {\n            format!(\"{}...\", &node.title[..57])\n        } else {\n            node.title.clone()\n        };\n\n        let cycle_mark = if is_cycle { \" [CYCLE]\" } else { \"\" };\n        let dep_type_str = node.dep_type.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"blocks\");\n\n        println!(\n            \"{}[{}] {} {} (P{}, {}){}\",\n            prefix,\n            node.id,\n            status_symbol(&node.status),\n            title,\n            node.priority,\n            dep_type_str,\n            cycle_mark\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_dep(beads_dir: &PathBuf, dep: DepCommands) -> Result<()> {\n    match dep {\n        DepCommands::Add {\n            blocks,\n            blocker,\n            type_,\n        } => {\n            let blocks = blocks.ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Missing --blocks argument. Usage: bf dep add <blocker> --blocks <blocked>\"))?;\n\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let dep_type =\n                crate::model::DependencyType::from_str(&type_).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n\n            // Add the dependency: blocks depends on blocker\n            storage.add_dependency(&blocks, &blocker, &dep_type, \"cli\")?;\n\n            // If this is a blocker dependency, update status to 'blocked'\n            if matches!(dep_type, crate::model::DependencyType::Blocks) {\n                let changes = IssueChanges {\n                    status: Some(Status::Blocked),\n                    ..Default::default()\n                };\n                storage.update_issue(&blocks, &changes)?;\n            }\n\n            println!(\n                \"Added dependency: {} depends on {} ({})\",\n                blocks, blocker, type_\n            );\n        }\n        DepCommands::Remove { issue, depends_on } => {\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            storage.remove_dependency(&issue, &depends_on)?;\n            println!(\"Removed dependency: {} -> {}\", issue, depends_on);\n        }\n        DepCommands::List { id } => {\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let deps = storage.get_dependencies(&id)?;\n            if deps.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"No dependencies found for {}\", id);\n            } else {\n                for dep in deps {\n                    println!(\n                        \"  {} depends on {} ({})\",\n                        dep.issue_id, dep.depends_on_id, dep.dep_type\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        DepCommands::Tree {\n            id,\n            direction,\n            max_depth,\n            format,\n            json,\n        } => {\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n\n            // Validate direction\n            let direction = match direction.as_str() {\n                \"down\" | \"up\" | \"both\" => direction.as_str(),\n                _ => {\n                    return Err(anyhow!(\n                        \"Invalid direction: {}. Use 'down', 'up', or 'both'\",\n                        direction\n                    ))\n                }\n            };\n\n            if format == \"json\" {\n                // JSON output format\n                if direction == \"both\" {\n                    let down_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"down\", max_depth)?;\n                    let up_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"up\", max_depth)?;\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"root_id\": id,\n                        \"direction\": direction,\n                        \"max_depth\": max_depth,\n                        \"downward\": down_nodes,\n                        \"upward\": up_nodes\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&output)?);\n                } else {\n                    let nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, direction, max_depth)?;\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"root_id\": id,\n                        \"direction\": direction,\n                        \"max_depth\": max_depth,\n                        \"nodes\": nodes\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&output)?);\n                }\n            } else {\n                // Text output format\n                if direction == \"both\" {\n                    // Show both directions separately\n                    println!(\n                        \"Dependency tree for {} (downward - what this depends on):\\n\",\n                        id\n                    );\n                    let down_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"down\", max_depth)?;\n                    print_dep_tree(&down_nodes, &storage)?;\n\n                    if !down_nodes.is_empty() {\n                        println!();\n                    }\n\n                    println!(\n                        \"Reverse dependency tree for {} (upward - what depends on this):\\n\",\n                        id\n                    );\n                    let up_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"up\", max_depth)?;\n                    print_dep_tree(&up_nodes, &storage)?;\n                } else {\n                    let nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, direction, max_depth)?;\n                    print_dep_tree(&nodes, &storage)?;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_label(beads_dir: &PathBuf, label: LabelCommands) -> Result<()> {\n    match label {\n
